extracted.name: Cranberry Rum Punch
extracted.description: Ginger ale gives this potent punch a favorite fizz; a generous dose of white sugar sweetens up the mix.
instruction_lines: In a medium-size punchbowl, stir cranberry juice and sugar together until the sugar dissolves. Mix in ginger ale, rum, and lemon and lime slices. Serve over ice.
